title: Pasta Salad
description: A fresh and light pasta salad perfect for summer picnics and gatherings. This vibrant dish combines al dente pasta with crisp vegetables and a simple olive oil dressing.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Add pasta and cook according to package instructions until al dente, usually 8-10 minutes.
Drain pasta and rinse under cold water to stop the cooking process.
While pasta cools, wash and chop the tomatoes into bite-sized pieces.
Wash and chop the lettuce into thin strips.
In a large bowl, combine the cooled pasta, chopped tomatoes, and lettuce.
Drizzle olive oil over the salad and toss gently to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
For best flavor, refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.

if_then_rules.then: add a pinch of red pepper flakes or fresh chopped chili
add an extra tablespoon of olive oil
add fresh herbs like basil or parsley

notes: This versatile salad can be customized with additional ingredients like cucumber, bell peppers, olives, or feta cheese. For a more substantial meal, add canned tuna or grilled chicken.

title: Cheese Omelette
description: A classic breakfast dish that's quick to prepare and packed with protein. This fluffy omelette filled with melted cheese is perfect for a satisfying morning meal.
steps: Crack eggs into a bowl and beat them until well mixed.
Add a splash of milk and whisk to incorporate. This helps make the omelette fluffy.
Grate the cheese if it's not already shredded.
Season the egg mixture with salt and pepper.
Heat a non-stick frying pan over medium heat.
Add a small knob of butter and let it melt, coating the bottom of the pan.
Pour in the egg mixture and let it cook for about 1 minute until it starts to set at the edges.
Sprinkle the cheese evenly over one half of the omelette.
When the eggs are mostly set but still slightly runny on top, use a spatula to fold the omelette in half.
Cook for another 30 seconds, then slide onto a plate and serve immediately.

if_then_rules.then: add more butter or use a non-stick pan
whisk the eggs vigorously before cooking
add chopped chives or parsley to the egg mixture

notes: For variation, try different types of cheese like cheddar, feta, or goat cheese. You can also add vegetables like spinach, mushrooms, or tomatoes.

title: Chicken Stir Fry
description: A quick and healthy meal full of lean protein and vegetables. This versatile stir fry combines tender chicken with fresh vegetables and can be ready in under 30 minutes.
steps: Slice the chicken breast into thin strips against the grain.
Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
Heat a wok or large frying pan over high heat until very hot.
Add 1 tablespoon of oil and swirl to coat the pan.
Add the chicken pieces and stir fry for 3-4 minutes until they begin to brown.
Remove the chicken and set aside.
Add remaining oil and the vegetables to the pan, stir frying for 2-3 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return the chicken to the pan and toss everything together.
Add soy sauce and any seasonings, then stir fry for another minute until everything is hot.
Serve immediately with cooked rice.

if_then_rules.then: add a tablespoon of water or chicken broth
mix 1 tablespoon cornstarch with 1/4 cup broth and add to the pan
add red pepper flakes or a drizzle of sriracha sauce

notes: You can substitute the chicken with beef, shrimp, or tofu for variety. This recipe works with any combination of vegetables you have available.

title: Simple Rice
description: Perfect, fluffy rice every time. This basic recipe is the foundation for countless meals and can be enhanced with herbs, spices, or broths to match any cuisine.
steps: Rinse the rice in cold water until the water runs clear, about 1-2 minutes.
Place the rice in a pot with 1.5 cups of water for every cup of rice.
Add a pinch of salt and bring to a boil over high heat.
Once boiling, reduce heat to low, cover with a tight-fitting lid, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Without removing the lid, remove from heat and let the rice rest for 5 minutes.
Fluff the rice with a fork before serving.

if_then_rules.if: the water evaporates before rice is soft
if_then_rules.then: add another 1/4 cup of water and continue cooking on low heat
use chicken or vegetable broth instead of water
rinse the rice thoroughly before cooking and avoid stirring during cooking

notes: Different rice varieties may require different water ratios and cooking times. Brown rice typically needs more water and a longer cooking time than white rice.

title: Pancake Breakfast
description: Light and fluffy homemade pancakes that make for a delicious weekend breakfast. Serve these golden pancakes warm with maple syrup, fresh fruit, or your favorite toppings.
steps: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In another bowl, beat the eggs, then add milk and melted butter.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined. Some lumps are okay.
Let the batter rest for 5 minutes to allow the gluten to relax.
Heat a non-stick frying pan or griddle over medium heat.
Add a small amount of butter or oil to coat the cooking surface.
Pour about 1/4 cup of batter for each pancake onto the hot pan.
Cook until bubbles form on the surface and the edges look set, about 2-3 minutes.
Flip the pancake and cook for another 1-2 minutes until golden brown.
Repeat with remaining batter, adding more butter to the pan as needed.

if_then_rules.then: add a little more milk to thin the batter

if_then_rules.if: the pancakes are browning too quickly
if_then_rules.then: reduce the heat to medium-low
let the batter rest for 10-15 minutes before cooking

notes: For added flavor, try adding vanilla extract, cinnamon, or blueberries to the batter. Leftover pancakes can be frozen with parchment paper between them and reheated in a toaster.

title: Party Nachos
description: Loaded nachos that are perfect for gatherings and game days. Crispy tortilla chips topped with melted cheese and jalapeños make for an irresistible shareable snack.
steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Spread the tortilla chips in an even layer on a large baking sheet.
Sprinkle two-thirds of the grated cheese evenly over the chips.
Slice the jalapeños into thin rounds, removing seeds if you prefer less heat.
Distribute the jalapeño slices over the cheese.
Sprinkle the remaining cheese on top.
Bake in the preheated oven for 5-7 minutes, until the cheese is fully melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 1 minute.
Serve immediately with salsa, guacamole, and sour cream on the side.

if_then_rules.then: bake the chips for 2 minutes before adding toppings

if_then_rules.if: you want a more substantial appetizer
if_then_rules.then: add cooked ground beef or black beans before the cheese
place under the broiler for 1-2 minutes, watching carefully

notes: For extra flavor, consider adding black olives, green onions, or diced tomatoes after baking. These nachos are best enjoyed immediately, as they can become soggy if left too long.

title: Vegetable Soup
description: A nourishing vegetable soup that's both healthy and comforting. This simple soup is packed with fresh vegetables and can be customized based on what's in your fridge.
steps: Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Dice the onion and add to the pot, cooking until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Peel and dice the carrots and add to the pot, cooking for 3 minutes.
Dice the celery and add to the pot, cooking for another 2 minutes.
Peel and dice the potatoes into 1/2-inch cubes.
Add the potatoes and stir to combine with the other vegetables.
Pour in the water or vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Season with salt, pepper, and herbs like thyme or bay leaf.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes until all vegetables are tender.
Taste and adjust seasoning before serving hot.

if_then_rules.then: blend one-third of the soup and return it to the pot
add a can of white beans or cooked chicken
add more herbs, a splash of vinegar, or a parmesan rind while simmering

notes: This soup freezes well for up to 3 months. For variations, try adding different vegetables like zucchini, green beans, or spinach. A squeeze of lemon juice just before serving brightens the flavors.

title: Club Sandwich
description: A classic triple-decker sandwich that's perfect for lunch or a light dinner. Layers of toasted bread, chicken, bacon, lettuce, and tomato create the ultimate satisfying sandwich.
steps: Cook the chicken breast in a pan over medium heat until fully cooked through, about 6-7 minutes per side.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes, then slice thinly.
Toast 6 slices of bread until golden brown.
Spread mayonnaise on one side of each piece of toast.
Place lettuce and sliced tomato on the first piece of toast.
Add the sliced chicken breast on top of the tomato.
Place the second piece of toast on top, mayonnaise side up.
Add bacon and more lettuce on the second layer.
Top with the final piece of toast, mayonnaise side down.
Secure the sandwich with toothpicks and cut diagonally into quarters to serve.

if_then_rules.then: use Greek yogurt instead of mayonnaise and turkey bacon instead of regular bacon
substitute the chicken and bacon with sliced avocado and grilled mushrooms

if_then_rules.if: the sandwich is too tall to eat
if_then_rules.then: press down gently after assembly and before cutting

notes: For extra flavor, add a slice of cheese or avocado. The chicken can be prepared ahead of time and refrigerated for quicker assembly. Serve with potato chips or a side salad for a complete meal.

title: Spaghetti Bolognese
description: A classic Italian comfort food featuring al dente spaghetti topped with a rich, meaty tomato sauce. This hearty dish is a family favorite that's perfect for weeknight dinners.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add finely chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant.
Add ground beef and break it apart with a wooden spoon, cooking until browned.
Pour in tomato sauce and stir to combine.
Season with salt, pepper, and Italian herbs.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20-30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Meanwhile, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook spaghetti according to package instructions until al dente.
Drain pasta and serve topped with the Bolognese sauce and grated Parmesan.

if_then_rules.then: add a splash of water or beef broth
add a splash of red wine after browning the meat
substitute the ground beef with lentils or plant-based meat alternative

notes: For an authentic touch, add a bay leaf to the sauce while simmering and remove before serving. The sauce can be made ahead of time and will taste even better the next day.

title: Fruit Salad
description: A refreshing and colorful mix of fresh fruits that makes for a healthy dessert or breakfast option. This simple dish brings together the natural sweetness of seasonal fruits in one delightful bowl.
steps: Wash all fruits thoroughly under cold running water.
Peel and core the apple, then cut into bite-sized chunks.
Peel the banana and slice into rounds.
Peel the orange, remove the white pith, and separate into segments or chunks.
Cut the grapes in half if they are large.
Combine all prepared fruits in a large bowl.
If desired, add a squeeze of lemon juice to prevent browning and add brightness.
Gently toss to mix all fruits together.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving for the flavors to blend.

if_then_rules.then: add a drizzle of honey or maple syrup

if_then_rules.if: the fruit is not very ripe
if_then_rules.then: let it sit at room temperature before preparing
add a sprinkle of cinnamon or mint leaves

notes: This is a very flexible recipe. Feel free to use whatever fruits are in season or that you have on hand. For a more substantial breakfast, serve with yogurt and granola.
